explication: One-KVM is an IP-KVM server. The principal workflow is browser authentication, API/WebSocket dispatch, device control or media acquisition, then delivery of video/audio/input results to the remote operator. Distinct stages include authentication, configuration, capture, encoding, transport, HID/MSD/ATX control, and optional integrations such as Redfish, computer-use automation, and managed extensions. The sampled excerpts confirm orchestration and several controller relationships; some unsampled handler-to-service links are represented only where route names and documented capabilities make them clear.
